name: LinkButton
description: `LinkButton` navigates to a URL while looking like a `Button`. Supply `href` for a native anchor destination.

props.name: alignContent
props.description: Whether the label sits centred or hugs the start edge when visuals are present.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretches the link to fill the width of its container.

props.name: count
props.description: Number shown in a trailing counter.

props.name: data-component
props.description: Overrides the marker used to identify this element in tests and styling.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents navigation and removes the link from the keyboard order.

props.name: inactive
props.description: Marks the link temporarily unavailable while keeping it focusable.

props.name: labelWrap
props.description: Lets a long label wrap onto more than one line instead of being clipped.

props.name: loading
props.description: Replaces the leading visual with a spinner and suppresses navigation.

props.name: loadingAnnouncement
props.description: Text announced to assistive technology while the link is loading.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called when the link is activated.

props.name: render
props.description: Renders the link as your own element, for a router link that still needs button styling.

props.name: size
props.description: Height and text size of the link.

props.name: trailingAction
props.description: Icon shown at the far end, conventionally a chevron.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight of the link. Use `primary` for the main action and `danger` for a destructive one.
